title: High-resolution S=4 Figure 1 response surfaces
purpose: Production-scale mixed-vs-positive response surfaces for the main environmental variance and synchrony figure.
rationale: Keep the first production batch focused on the current Figure 1 comparison: S=4 mixed slopes versus positive aligned slopes.
Use 1000 replicates per scenario to make Monte Carlo uncertainty visually and rhetorically negligible for the final paper.
Densify sigma_env across the current coarse range and add extra resolution above 1.0, where the interim display concentrated much of the visual change.
Use feasible negative rho_env values for S=4 and a finer positive-correlation gradient, while retaining rho_env=1.0 as the aligned endpoint with rho_eff recorded in outputs.
acceptance_checks: The combined parquet validates against the production manifest.
Rows equal 570000, with 1000 replicates for every scenario.
rho_eff and rho_clipped are present and manifest-consistent.
Mean extinction or floor occupancy patterns at high sigma_env are inspected before using high-sigma regions in manuscript claims.
New surfaces are compared with the current coarse Figure 1 before replacing display defaults.
